resources.string: tiny-voca by Muhammed Nazeem · native ggml runtime via llama.cpp\nApache-2.0 · F2 and M2 voices · 24 kHz
To use tiny-voca across Android: open system TTS settings, select \"tiny-voca TTS\" as the preferred engine, then choose F2 or M2. Everything runs offline; no internet permission is requested.
